name: WiFi Client & Rogue AP Attacks
description: Ability to assess WiFi client-side security through rogue access point deployment, client deauthentication attacks, karma/MANA attacks, captive portal credential harvesting, and client probe request analysis. Covers both targeted client attacks and broad rogue AP detection assessment to evaluate organizational exposure.

0.label: None

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands client-side WiFi vulnerabilities and rogue AP concepts
evidence: Can explain how rogue access points and evil twin attacks work
Understands probe request information leakage and auto-association risks
Completed training on WiFi client attack vectors and countermeasures

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Deploys rogue APs and executes client attacks in controlled environments under supervision
evidence: Deployed a rogue AP with captive portal in a lab environment under guidance
Performed client deauthentication attacks and observed reconnection behavior

evidence: Independently planned and conducted WiFi client attack assessments for 3+ engagements
